item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan brgyud kyi sngon 'gro gsol 'debs
item.coloph: ces tshig mtha' bsgyur/ nyams rgyud brgyud pa can gyi gsol 'debs kyi rim pa brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs chen po las cung tsam bsdus te/ gongi ma'i dgongs pa ji ltar bsdus shing / phyi rabs dag snang bskyed pa'i yan lag tu bru yi gshen po rgyal ba g.yung drung gis sbyar ba'o//
